verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch is not itself an AI agent but an API-development platform, so shipping an official MCP server is a fair axis, and docs explicitly confirm one exists ('Connect AI agents to Hoppscotch with the MCP server') that grants agents read/write access to collections, requests, environments, and teams. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of the MCP server working in practice and more detail on setup/auth scope.
